questions.markdown:
A single-phase motor operating at 50 Hz draws a current of 20 A at a 0.75 lagging power factor from a 230 V sinusoidal supply.

Obtain the required kVAr and capacitance to be connected in parallel to improve the power factor to 0.9 lagging. Also, determine the new supply current.

A balanced star-connected load with a per-phase impedance of $(20 + j\,50)\ \Omega$ is supplied by a 3-phase, 400 V, 50 Hz balanced source in RYB sequence. Using $V_{RY}$ as the reference phasor, calculate the phasor currents in each line, the power factor, the power consumed, the reactive VA, and the total VA.

When connected to a 3-phase motor, two wattmeters indicate a total power input of 12 kW with a power factor of 0.6 lagging. Determine the individual wattmeter readings and the reactive power of the motor.

An iron ring with a mean diameter of 30 cm is made from cylindrical iron rod of cross-sectional diameter 2.5 cm.

A saw-cut of 1 mm width is introduced to create an air gap. A coil with 500 turns is wound around the ring.

Calculate the current required in the coil to produce a magnetic flux of 4 mWb within the ring. Assume a relative permeability of 800 for the iron at this flux density and an absolute permeability of air value of $4\pi \times 10^{-7}\ \text{H/m}$.

Neglect any leakage or fringing effects.
